newsitem.title: USA: America Online plans pricing announcements.
newsitem.headline: America Online plans pricing announcements.

text.p: America Online Corp said on Thursday that it will make announcements, including one involving its pricing, "very soon."
The company said it was responding to Microsoft, which said earlier in the day that it was relaunching its online service, Microsoft Network.
AOL's announcement would be the third part of the company's fall initiatives and involve pricing, said company spokeswoman Pam McGraw.

McGraw said earlier that initiatives include an announcement in September that AOL would generate revenue by offering advertisements and electronic commerce and a second announcement that the company was beginning a new television campaign.
"The third piece is new member experience, which will include pricing for the AOL service," McGraw said.
